query: Turn this toolkit SOP markdown into a downloadable branded PDF.
expected_behavior: Renders the markdown from the Facilitron-branded LaTeX template (brand fonts, logo, eyebrow kicker, stat cards, dashboard tables, fillable checkboxes) rather than plain default styling
Before generation, requires an explicit Drive folder/file ID or a user-selected non-temporary local folder and rejects temporary or repository destinations
Reserves the pandoc-from-markdown path as a fallback for quick prose-only output, not the primary branded render

Generates inside one unique scratch workspace, cleans it on success and failure, and returns the exact durable Drive URL or verified absolute path plus review state, owner, approver, target surface, Jira key, asset references, and website handoff
